title: abandon path calls git checkout main best-effort; on a dirty worktree the check…
description:
abandon path calls git checkout main best-effort; on a dirty worktree the checkout can silently fail leaving HEAD on the cam/* branch. The failure mode is safe (the next plan tick re-detects the branch conflict and re-pauses rather than clobbering), but a follow-up could surface the failed checkout to the operator instead of silently re-pausing.

Source: cam/issue-153
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: 103b9d0057f6

spec.scope: In the abandon path, when the best-effort `git checkout main` fails (e.g. a dirty worktree leaves HEAD on the cam/* branch), surface the failed checkout to the operator instead of silently re-pausing. Preserve the existing safe fallback: never clobber the worktree, and the next plan tick still re-detects the branch conflict.
acceptanceCriteria: When the abandon-path `git checkout main` fails, the failure is surfaced to the operator (durable marker or notification line naming the branch HEAD is stuck on), not silently swallowed.
The existing safe behavior is preserved: a dirty worktree is never clobbered and the next plan tick still re-detects the branch conflict.
A test covers the failed-checkout branch and asserts the operator-facing surfacing.
gotchas: The current failure mode is already SAFE (re-pauses); this change is observability only. Do not change the never-clobber guarantee.
